images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Cape Cod styl

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a 1940s Cape-ish 1.5-storey house with a front gable over a tripartite picture window, a door with a light at the side, shrubs along the foundation

why.note: the 1930s-40s Cape Cod revival: small, steep, cheap, nostalgic
